card.name: Inside foreign-script glosses in text
card.fires_on: Characters partway through a non-Latin word (Chinese, Japanese, Greek, Arabic script) given as a gloss next to an English explanation. It responds to the character that falls inside or ends the foreign term.

modes.label: Chinese or Japanese terms
modes.description: A character within a Chinese or Japanese term placed in parentheses after an English name.
modes.example: promotion of written vernacular Chinese (白<<话>>)

modes.label: Greek or Arabic-script words
modes.description: A letter inside a Greek or Persian word quoted to explain an etymology.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a foreign-script word, such as Chinese character endings, and away from other completions.
card.plain: It fires on a character inside a foreign-language word quoted in brackets to explain an English term.
